description: Results of matches: a service with `results` in neblla_update_app({ business: { booking } }) makes each of its sessions, once played, a match between side "A" and "B"; with neblla_update_app({ matches }) each game a room starts is one too. When the players disagree it is disputed and counts for nothing until the developer settles it. "disputes" → the queue, oldest first: { match, set, title, start, deadline, players: [{ user, name, team, said: { winner, score? }, tally: { reported, disputed, lost, ratio, hint, cheater? } }], chat? }; "player" { user } → their tally (hint: true when they pass the threshold of a cheater, results.cheaterHint); "cheaters" → those declared. Changes nothing; neblla_matches settles, annuls and declares.
name: neblla_matches_read
title: Matches (read)
